title: Beat Key help text proofread
intro: Every help box in Beat Key 0.1.81 (app, pocket and plug-in share one table): 81 lines. Mark each OK or Fix; type the wording you want (or what's wrong) in the notes box. Huh? = you can't tell what it means. The inversion line already shows tonight's fix (not shipped yet).

items.title: READOUT
items.see: Paste, open or listen to read a beat.

items.title: BPM
items.see: Click: normal, double or half time.
Halve or double the BPM.

items.title: KEY
items.see: Key heard. Ring and % show how sure.

items.title: LOCKED · UNSURE
items.do: Hover LOCKED · UNSURE with HELP on.
items.see: LOCKED = sure. UNSURE = close call.

items.title: TOP KEYS
items.do: Hover TOP KEYS with HELP on.
items.see: Three likeliest keys. Click to pin, again to unpin.

items.title: MANUAL
items.see: Pin any of the 24 keys.

items.title: PINNED KEY
items.do: Hover PINNED KEY with HELP on.
items.see: Click to unpin.

items.title: KEYBOARD
items.see: Play A W S E D F T G Y H U J K. Z X: octave.

items.title: SCALE
items.see: The key's seven notes.

items.title: TUNING
items.see: Cents off standard pitch. Green = in tune.

items.title: CAMELOT
items.see: Camelot code for DJ mixing.

items.title: FILE
items.see: File read, and its folder.

items.title: SHOW IN FINDER
items.do: Hover SHOW IN FINDER with HELP on.
items.see: Reveal the file in Finder.

items.title: PREVIOUS FILE
items.do: Hover PREVIOUS FILE with HELP on.
items.see: Previous file (←)

items.title: NEXT FILE
items.do: Hover NEXT FILE with HELP on.
items.see: Next file (→)

items.title: STATUS
items.see: READY, WORKING, FAILED or LIVE.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: LINK
items.see: Paste a YouTube link.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: DOWNLOAD
items.see: Get MP3, BPM and key. Empty field: clipboard link.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: LOG IN TO YOUTUBE
items.do: Hover LOG IN TO YOUTUBE with HELP on.
items.see: Open YouTube sign-in. Login stays on this Mac.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: OPEN AUDIO
items.do: Hover OPEN AUDIO with HELP on.
items.see: Choose or drop audio files, any number.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: FIND KEY/BPM
items.do: Hover FIND KEY/BPM with HELP on.
items.see: Get BPM and key. Arrows page files.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: SOURCE
items.see: System audio or an input. Meter shows level.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: LISTEN
items.see: Live BPM and key. Nothing recorded or saved.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: HOLD
items.see: Freeze the reading. Click again to follow.

items.section: Window and pocket: getting audio in
items.title: NEW SONG
items.do: Hover NEW SONG with HELP on.
items.see: Clear the listen reading, start fresh.

items.title: SEND TO DAW
items.do: Hover SEND TO DAW with HELP on.
items.see: Send BPM and key to the open DAW.

items.title: SEND TO AUTO-TUNE
items.do: Hover SEND TO AUTO-TUNE with HELP on.
items.see: Set key in Auto-Tune, Tune Real-Time (⌃⌥⌘A)

items.title: EXPORT MIDI
items.do: Hover EXPORT MIDI with HELP on.
items.see: MIDI file with tempo and key.

items.title: ANALYZE FILE
items.do: Hover ANALYZE FILE with HELP on.
items.see: Pick audio files, get BPM and key.

items.title: WINDOW
items.see: Open the full window.

items.title: QUIT
items.see: Quit Beat Key.

items.title: RECENT
items.see: Past readings. Pick one to bring it back.

items.title: SETTINGS
items.see: Display, listen source, shortcuts, login.

items.title: COLOR
items.see: Pick the display colour. Reset to Amber.

items.title: REPORT
items.see: Send a report, log attached.

items.title: ADVANCED
items.see: Add key wheel, chords, MATCH TO. First switch sets both.

items.title: HELP
items.see: Help on. Hover for tips. Click to turn off.

items.title: PITCH TO FIT
items.do: Hover PITCH TO FIT with HELP on.
items.see: Semitones to pitch the beat into your key.

items.title: KEY WHEEL
items.do: Hover KEY WHEEL with HELP on.
items.see: Circle of fifths. Click a key to pin it.

items.title: NOTES HEARD
items.do: Hover NOTES HEARD with HELP on.
items.see: Note strength. Dotted = in the scale.

items.title: CHORDS
items.see: Click to hear. Drag to a DAW as MIDI.

items.title: TRIAD · 7TH · 9TH
items.see: Chord size: 3 notes, add 7th, add 7th and 9th.

items.title: INVERSION
items.see: Root position, 1st inversion, 2nd inversion. OPEN = spread.

items.title: BAR
items.see: Bars per chord when dragged out as MIDI.

items.title: BORROWED
items.see: Chords from the parallel major or minor.

items.title: MATCH TO
items.do: Hover MATCH TO with HELP on.
items.see: Pick your project's key. See the pitch to fit.
Semitones to pitch. The lit one fits.

items.title: MINI
items.see: Small always-on-top chord pad. Plays over MIDI.

items.title: BEAT KEY MINI
items.do: Hover BEAT KEY MINI with HELP on.
items.see: Pads play MIDI in "Beat Key". Keys 1-7, Q W E R.

items.title: SOUND
items.see: Also play chords on Beat Key's piano.

items.title: HIGH CONTRAST
items.do: Hover HIGH CONTRAST with HELP on.
items.see: Brighter text, no glow. Lamp shapes stay.

items.title: LISTEN TO
items.do: Hover LISTEN TO with HELP on.
items.see: System audio or one input. Nothing saved.

items.title: CHANNEL
items.see: Interface channel to read, or all.

items.title: START OVER AFTER
items.do: Hover START OVER AFTER with HELP on.
items.see: Silence length that ends a song.

items.title: FILE NAMES
items.do: Hover FILE NAMES with HELP on.
items.see: Add key + BPM to names. Pro Tools files always ask.

items.title: OPEN AT LOGIN
items.do: Hover OPEN AT LOGIN with HELP on.
items.see: Start Beat Key at login.

items.title: SHORTCUTS
items.see: Quick Keys: every shortcut. Click one, type new keys.

items.title: SET UP PERMISSIONS
items.do: Hover SET UP PERMISSIONS with HELP on.
items.see: Checks each permission. Menu: Set Up Permissions…

items.title: SCREEN & SYSTEM AUDIO RECORDING
items.do: Hover SCREEN & SYSTEM AUDIO RECORDING with HELP on.
items.see: Hear Mac audio. Turn on Beat Key.

items.title: MICROPHONE
items.see: Hear a mic or interface. Turn on Beat Key.

items.title: ACCESSIBILITY
items.see: Type BPM and key into your DAW. Turn on Beat Key.

items.title: RUN DOCTOR
items.do: Hover RUN DOCTOR with HELP on.
items.see: Check and repair downloader, ffmpeg, analyzer.

items.title: DOCTOR RESULT
items.do: Hover DOCTOR RESULT with HELP on.
items.see: OK · FIXED IT · FOUND A PROBLEM (see line below)

items.title: OCTAVE · Z X
items.do: Hover OCTAVE · Z X with HELP on.
items.see: Z octave down, X up. Link field empty.

items.title: MAJOR / MINOR · SPACE
items.do: Hover MAJOR / MINOR · SPACE with HELP on.
items.see: Space flips the keyboard major/minor.

items.title: PAGE FILES · ← →
items.do: Hover PAGE FILES · ← → with HELP on.
items.see: Arrows page files. Link field empty.

items.title: AUTO-TUNE SHORTCUT
items.do: Hover AUTO-TUNE SHORTCUT with HELP on.
items.see: Send key to Auto-Tune (⌃⌥⌘A)

items.title: ADVANCED SHORTCUT
items.do: Hover ADVANCED SHORTCUT with HELP on.
items.see: Advanced on/off (⌥⌘A)

items.title: HELP WINDOW · ⌘?
items.do: Hover HELP WINDOW · ⌘? with HELP on.
items.see: Help › Beat Key Help. Help Mode: hover tips.

items.section: Key wheel hover (text changes with the reading)
items.title: KEY WHEEL · Any wheel key, no reading yet.
items.do: Any wheel key, no reading yet.
items.see: Click to use it as the key.

items.section: Key wheel hover (text changes with the reading)
items.title: KEY WHEEL · The key Beat Key picked.
items.see: Beat Key's pick: the closest match to what it heard.

items.section: Key wheel hover (text changes with the reading)
items.title: KEY WHEEL · Relative major/minor of the pick (example names).
items.do: Relative major/minor of the pick (example names).
items.see: The relative minor of Am: the same seven notes, so the two are easy to mix up.

items.section: Key wheel hover (text changes with the reading)
items.title: KEY WHEEL · A neighbour key on the circle.
items.do: A neighbour key on the circle.
items.see: Next to Am on the circle of fifths. They differ by one note, so they fit together.

items.section: Key wheel hover (text changes with the reading)
items.title: KEY WHEEL · Parallel major/minor.
items.see: Same root as Am, but major. Three notes differ.

items.section: Key wheel hover (text changes with the reading)
items.title: KEY WHEEL · Any far-away key (count changes).
items.see: Shares 4 of 7 notes with Am, so it clashes.

items.section: Key wheel hover (text changes with the reading)
items.title: KEY WHEEL · The key you pinned.
items.see: Pinned. Click to unpin.

items.section: Plain Mac tooltips (show without HELP on)
items.title: QUICK KEYS · NO SHORTCUT
items.do: Quick Keys window, the clear button.
items.see: Leave this action without a shortcut

items.section: Plain Mac tooltips (show without HELP on)
items.title: REPORT · SAVE
items.see: Save the report as a folder.

items.section: Plain Mac tooltips (show without HELP on)
items.title: REPORT BUTTON
items.see: Send a report, log attached.

items.section: Plain Mac tooltips (show without HELP on)
items.title: MENU BAR ITEM
items.do: Hover the Beat Key item in the menu bar.
items.see: No reading yet  /  Nothing read  /  Key Am · 120 BPM · Manual

legend: Tab to a row, then O OK · F Fix · H Huh? · S Skip (same key again clears it). Type the wording you want in the notes box.
